evals.prompt: How do I unit test a ViewModel that uses viewModelScope to launch a coroutine and emits a StateFlow?
evals.expected_output: Use runTest from kotlinx-coroutines-test. Apply MainDispatcherRule to replace Main dispatcher with TestDispatcher/StandardTestDispatcher. Inject DispatcherProvider. Mock dependencies with MockK or fake repositories. Collect StateFlow with turbine or awaitItem.

evals.prompt: How do I test a Composable screen that requires a real ViewModel with Hilt injection?
evals.expected_output: Use createAndroidComposeRule with HiltAndroidRule. Replace production modules with @TestInstallIn to inject fake repositories. Access the composable via composeTestRule.setContent.

evals.prompt: My UI test uses Thread.sleep(2000) to wait for an async operation. Why is that bad and what should I use instead?
evals.expected_output: Thread.sleep is flaky — too short causes failures, too long wastes time. Use composeTestRule.waitUntil { } for Compose or IdlingResource for View-based tests to wait for real conditions.

evals.prompt: How do I test activity state restoration versus true process death on Android?
evals.expected_output: ActivityScenario.recreate() only recreates the activity after a configuration change; it is activity recreation, not OS process death. Prove process death by terminating the app process (for example adb shell am kill, or a driver-level terminate) and verifying the approved restoration path on cold relaunch. StateRestorationTester and rememberSaveable/SavedStateHandle cover lower-layer saveable-state restoration only and never substitute for termination/relaunch evidence; SavedStateHandle restores state only because the app was actually restarted. Without an identified native terminate/relaunch execution, report the process-death cell BLOCKED. Robolectric or Compose UI tests never substitute native device execution.

assertions.description: Distinguishes activity recreation from process death
Requires an identified process termination mechanism (am kill or driver terminate)
Requires relaunch/restart evidence, not activity recreation
Keeps unevaluated process death BLOCKED instead of claimed as verified
Rejects presenting lower-layer restoration as process death proof
